title: Split TermAl src/engram_host_adapter.rs below 2,500 lines
outcome: TermAl's Engram adapter is easier to inspect without changing authorization, transport or recovery behavior.
acceptance: A host-observed automated test proves src/engram_host_adapter.rs and every module extracted from it are each at most 2,499 physical lines at the final source revision. Evidence lists every covered path and before/after count; include blank/comment lines and a nonempty final unterminated line. Newly extracted modules must not escape the inventory.

A lightweight size check for this file family runs in normal validation and fails at 2,500 lines, passes at 2,499, counts LF/CRLF consistently, and refuses an empty or failed inventory. Reuse one shared checker if already available; do not build a new framework per task.

Independent-session final acceptance cites the fresh host-observed line-count test evidence. Completion must remain blocked when that bound evidence is missing, failed or stale; demonstrate that gating safely on an isolated fixture rather than relaxing the live task. A plan evaluation or author-written gate note is not a substitute for the observed size result.

Split only this file's responsibilities into ordinary modules without behavior, schema/SQL or public-interface changes. Preserve existing tests/assertions and pass relevant regressions plus required project gates/review. No minification, duplicate implementation, deleted tests or transferring the oversized body to another oversized file.
